annotations.title: Measured token-supply change for one network (paid)

description: Paid: 1 credit ($1.00) per answered call, charged once and only after a non-empty answer is computed; an unavailable answer, a refusal or an error costs nothing. Send your API key in the X-API-Key header or as api_key. Each call is a new answer and a new charge (no idempotency key). For one DePIN network: each first-party on-chain supply series it has (eligible metrics whose name contains 'supply', e.g. onchain_total_supply), its daily close at the latest complete UTC day and 7 and 30 days earlier, the percentage changes, and each change annualised by compounding ((end/start)^(365/days) - 1, so a 7-day move is heavily amplified). A series with 2 or fewer distinct daily closes in 30 days is not used (a stuck feed cannot be told from a fixed supply). Every endpoint carries its as_of and verify_url; nothing is interpolated. No exchange-listing, price, funding, market-cap or aggregator data is used; the tool name is historical. Networks without an eligible supply series are answered unavailable and not charged.

api_key.description: Your API key, only if your client cannot send the X-API-Key header.

symbol.description: One network ticker, e.g. AKT, FIL, RENDER.
